metadata.handoff_strategy: Marking Studio genera SVG/PNG; Sculpfun Space/LightBurn/LaserGRBL conservan control de GRBL, velocidad, potencia, origen, Frame y seguridad.
metadata.safety: No se incluyen parámetros universales de potencia/velocidad: deben calibrarse por material y carcasa.
metadata.positioning_default: Fixed physical jig + Current Position or User Origin + Frame before every production batch.
metadata.absolute_coordinates_caution: Do not rely on repeatable Absolute Coordinates after restart unless homing/limit switches are installed, enabled and physically validated.
metadata.homing_assumption: Treat limit switches/homing as not guaranteed on the base S9 Pro installation; detect actual controller state before relying on homing.
metadata.sculpfun_space_support: Official Sculpfun Space supports non-galvo SCULPFUN machines and imports SVG; suitable handoff alternative on Windows/macOS.
metadata.existing_shop_settings_priority: Settings already proven by the engraving area on this exact machine/material/surface are the baseline; Marking Studio can import/capture them read-only.
metadata.focus_reference_source: SCULPFUN S9 Pro manual: focus is 50 mm below the lower edge of the aluminum laser-module shell; supplied 50 mm measuring column.
